QF.id: Duplicate Share Certificates and Transmission of Securities_14

question.text: Which standard reason code is used by reporting entities for CBDT reporting when securities are transmitted from a nominee to legal heirs?

answer.text: TSL (Transfer of Securities to Legal heirs)

explanation.text: The Logic: Reporting entities use the standard reason code "TLH" (Transmission to Legal Heirs) when reporting to CBDT for transmission of securities from a nominee to legal heirs. The Trap: All four options look like plausible abbreviations. The exact workbook code is TLH — note that it starts with "T" for Transmission, not Transfer, reinforcing that transmission and transfer are distinct concepts. Note: The TLH code is the narrow, source-backed reporting tag for the nominee-to-legal-heir CBDT reporting flow; it is not a general code for every kind of transfer to legal heirs.
